item.title: Minden St. Jude Auction collects $2.7M to help cure childhood cancer
item.description: The 2026 Minden St. Jude Auction is in the books. Above, co-chairs Laura Hollingsworth (left) and Melissa Brown reveal this year’s total of $2,718,301, the most ever collected during the annual event. For more photos and information about the auction, see Tuesday’s Webster Parish Journal.

item.title: Word of the Day: Aphorism
item.description: Phonetic: /aph·o·rism/Part of Speech: NounDefinition: a pithy observation that contains a general truth, such as, “if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.”. “the old aphorism “the child is father to the man””Similar: saying, maxim, axiom, adage
